name: Dynamic MLP Maps with Empty Space Skipping
definition: A rendering technique for volumetric videos that uses a hybrid representation of multi-level hash tables and 2D CNN-generated MLP maps, combined with empty space skipping via an occupancy volume to achieve real-time performance.
summary: Dynamic MLP Maps with Empty Space Skipping is a volumetric video rendering technique that uses CNN-generated MLP maps and per-frame occupancy volumes to dynamically skip empty space for real-time performance.
